purpose: Independent bounded process observation for the browser-profile-open singleton-safety experiment.

serialization.json: RFC 8259 UTF-8; duplicate object keys, unknown keys, non-integer numbers, and values outside their declared domains are invalid
serialization.control_log: one compact JSON object followed by LF per record; one append-only writer; an unterminated active tail is pending rather than a record
serialization.atomic_files: write a sibling temporary regular file, fsync it, rename it over the destination, reopen it, and require byte-for-byte readback equality
serialization.integer_domain: unsigned 64-bit integer unless a narrower bound is stated

digest_domains.process_identity_input: canonical [pid,start_sec,start_usec] array; digest before an identity enters any sanitized set

digest_set_encoding.set_rule: Every process set is an RFC 8785 array of unique lowercase-hex process_identity_digest strings sorted by ascending digest bytes, then hashed with that set's declared domain. The empty set is the digest of the literal empty array under that domain.
digest_set_encoding.sample_identity_set: digest_domains.sample_identity_set and set_rule over exactly the target-uid identities in one complete sample
digest_set_encoding.contained_group: digest_domains.contained_group and set_rule over retained exact identities observed in the frozen group
digest_set_encoding.controlled_lineage: digest_domains.controlled_lineage and set_rule over the sticky browser-root lineage fixed point
digest_set_encoding.contained_closure: digest_domains.contained_closure and set_rule over the stated retained or live contained closure projection
digest_set_encoding.sticky_descendant_closure: digest_domains.sticky_descendant_closure and set_rule over descendants only, never the root identity itself, independently for direct-open-root, relay-root, and topology-candidate-root
digest_set_encoding.token_set: digest_domains.token_set and set_rule over exact argv token matches
digest_set_encoding.bundle_tree_set: digest_domains.bundle_tree_set and set_rule over opened executable objects classified in the frozen canonical bundle tree
digest_set_encoding.sample_sequence: digest_domains.sample_sequence over the RFC 8785 ordered array of exact sanitized_sample objects

rules: Every named argument occurs exactly once and no other argument is accepted.
The token is the exact 1 through 512 bytes of token-file, contains no NUL, CR, or LF byte, and is forbidden in argv, environment values, file names, and directory names.
token-file, control-log, latest-state, and final-summary are invocation-owned run-local paths supplied by the runner.
latest-state and final-summary must be distinct non-symlink regular-file destinations in an invocation-owned directory.
control-log is an invocation-owned non-symlink regular file opened read-only with no-follow semantics by the probe; the opened file identity is pinned for the run.
bundle-root and selected-executable are admission-frozen canonical objects; their paths are input only and are never emitted.
A CLI or path-contract violation is scan-incomplete; if final-summary cannot be safely resolved, the probe exits nonzero without substituting another destination.

control_log_transport.writer: The court is the sole writer. It opens the pinned regular file with append and no-follow semantics, writes each complete compact control_record plus LF with one bounded write call, fsyncs the same descriptor, and never truncates, replaces, or rewrites a byte.
control_log_transport.reader: The probe retains its read offset and an unterminated suffix. It parses only LF-terminated records and treats a currently unterminated suffix as pending while scanning continues.
control_log_transport.failure: File-identity change, size decrease, a complete invalid record, a pending suffix longer than control_record_max_bytes, or any nonempty pending suffix when final-inventory-complete or abort is consumed is control-invalid and scan-incomplete.
control_log_transport.ordering: A control takes effect in a sample exactly when sample.control_sequence_seen is greater than or equal to that control sequence; the court never derives a scanner fact from a sample with a smaller value as though that control had already applied.

root_control_causality.rule: A non-null root control carries an already-created exact PID/start identity. It never claims that scanner acknowledgement preceded process creation.
root_control_causality.observation: Every controlled browser-root or direct-open-root must exact-match an identity actually retained by the scanner. A prior retained observation may satisfy the match when it proves that same exact identity; otherwise the first complete sample after the control must observe it live.
root_control_causality.miss: If the first complete sample after a non-null root control neither matches it nor finds a prior retained exact match, that root is root-unobserved and the run is scan-incomplete. Empty descendant sets from an unobserved root can never pass a related stage.
root_control_causality.browser_ack: After browser-root, the court may continue dependent stages only after latest_state.root_observations.browser-root is observed. Direct-open-root necessarily follows spawn and must be observed before open-request exit adjudication. Relay and topology-candidate roles are independently derived by the scanner.
root_control_causality.exit_snapshot: For each observed direct-open, relay, or topology-candidate root, its exit snapshot is the first later complete sample that proves the exact root absent. No exit or empty-live-descendant fact exists before that snapshot.
root_control_causality.final_snapshot: The final-inventory snapshot is the complete sentinel sample whose control_sequence_seen is greater than or equal to the final-inventory-complete sequence.

enumeration_scope.projection: Only processes whose PROC_PIDTBSDINFO uid equals target-uid enter sample rows, group_member_count, identity retention, lineage, and every sanitized set.
enumeration_scope.non_target: A successfully read non-target uid is excluded and does not consume process_row_max or group_member_max; there is no exception.
enumeration_scope.unknown_uid: Failure to determine uid for a listed live PID is incomplete enumeration and scan-incomplete; it is never silently treated as non-target.
enumeration_scope.group_count: group_member_count is the count of target-uid sample rows whose observed PGID equals the frozen browser PGID.

shape.sequence: integer in [0,15], beginning at zero and increasing by exactly one

role_rules.browser-root: process is non-null; occurs exactly once
role_rules.ownership-boundary: process is null; occurs exactly once after browser-root; the first complete sample started after this record is the frozen ownership snapshot
role_rules.direct-open-root: process is non-null; occurs at most once
role_rules.final-inventory-complete: process is null; occurs exactly once on a normal run and causes the next sample to be the sentinel
role_rules.abort: process is null; occurs at most once, is terminal, and causes scan-incomplete

ordering: browser-root precedes ownership-boundary, direct-open-root, and final-inventory-complete.
No record follows final-inventory-complete or abort.

A repeated, out-of-order, oversized, or unknown-field complete record is control-invalid and makes the run scan-incomplete; active unterminated bytes follow control_log_transport rather than being parsed as a record.

derived_relay_classification.authority: relay-root and topology-candidate-root are scanner-derived roles, never court controls
derived_relay_classification.candidate_universe: Every target-uid identity other than the exact direct-open-root, observed outside the frozen group with the owned token or selected/bundle executable match and a kernel start strictly after direct-open-root, enters the bounded candidate universe; no resemblance filter may discard a candidate before frozen predicates are evaluated. The direct-open-root can never be a member of this universe because an identity cannot start strictly after itself.
derived_relay_classification.primary_predicates: selected executable file identity and digest match, exact owned token match, and kernel start after direct spawn but no more than limits.relay_first_start_window_ms later
derived_relay_classification.auxiliary_predicates: PPID equals 1 and PGID remains outside the frozen contained group
derived_relay_classification.g1_exemption: The direct-open-root is exempt from outside token and bundle-tree projections only while that exact identity remains live and its elapsed time since kernel start is at most limits.relay_exit_deadline_ms; it is never a candidate_universe member or classification bucket member. Within the candidate universe, after relay-root precedence, a candidate is live-g1-exemption exactly when all primary predicates hold, at least one auxiliary predicate fails, that exact identity remains live, and its elapsed time since kernel start is at most limits.relay_exit_deadline_ms. No resemblance, token-only, bundle-only, expired, additional, or otherwise unclassified identity is exempt.
derived_relay_classification.classification: Every candidate enters exactly one mutually exclusive bucket in this order: all primary and auxiliary predicates yields relay-root; otherwise the exact g1_exemption predicate yields live-g1-exemption; every other candidate yields topology-candidate-root. Token and bundle-tree outside counts are overlapping witness projections of the topology-candidate bucket, not additional buckets.
derived_relay_classification.conservation: candidate_observed_count equals classified_relay_count plus topology_candidate_count plus live_g1_exemption_count; every candidate contributes exactly once to that equality even when it contributes to both outside-witness projections.
derived_relay_classification.multiplicity: root_role relay-root and topology-candidate-root may each belong to multiple exact identities. All are retained with separate sticky descendant closures; classified_relay_count and topology_candidate_count enumerate the complete sets. Two or more classified relays is an UNSAFE_ESCAPED_PROCESS fact, never truncation or scan incompleteness.
derived_relay_classification.limits: The candidate universe and its relevant events are bounded by relevant_event_max; overflow is scan-incomplete and never truncation.

process_identity.publication: run-local only; forbidden in final-summary and every external receipt

shape.sequence: integer in [0,9999], beginning at zero and increasing by exactly one
shape.end_mono_ns: integer greater than or equal to start_mono_ns
shape.start_interval_ns: null for sequence zero; otherwise start_mono_ns minus the preceding sample start_mono_ns
shape.control_sequence_seen: greatest valid control sequence consumed before start_mono_ns, or null
shape.process_row_count: integer in [0,4096] equal to identity_ids length
shape.identity_ids: array of unique identity_row id values sorted by process identity
shape.identity_set_sha256: digest_domains.sample_identity_set digest of the sorted sanitized process-identity digest array; run-local integer ids never enter this digest

ordering: Sequence zero is the sole first sample.
Every sample before the final-inventory-complete control record after sequence zero is internal.
The first sample started after consuming final-inventory-complete is the sole sentinel and no sample follows it.
A sample with complete false makes the run scan-incomplete; it remains recorded and is never converted to a truncated complete sample.

sanitized_sample.publication_scope: May enter final-summary digests; contains no run-local integer identity id or raw process identity.

shape.process_identity_digests: array of the sample's unique digest_set_encoding.process_identity_digest strings, sorted by ascending digest bytes; length equals process_row_count

sanitized_sample.sequence_digest: sample_sequence_digest hashes the RFC 8785 array of these exact objects in ascending sequence order with digest_domains.sample_sequence.

shape.id: run-local integer in [0,16383], stable for one exact pid/start identity
shape.parent_identity_id: identity_row id observed live in the same sample, or null
shape.executable_id: executable_row id, or null when observation_status is not live
shape.token_match: boolean or null when procargs could not be completely classified
shape.selected_executable_match: boolean or null when executable identity could not be completely classified
shape.bundle_tree_match: boolean or null when executable identity could not be completely classified
shape.in_frozen_group: boolean or null before the frozen group is known or when PGID could not be read
shape.last_seen_sample: sample sequence greater than or equal to first_seen_sample
shape.root_roles: unique root_role values sorted by ascending UTF-8 bytes and directly assigned by valid control records
shape.lineage_root_roles: unique root_role values sorted by ascending UTF-8 bytes and inherited under sticky_lineage

identity_row.publication: run-local latest-state only; pid, ppid, pgid, start fields, and ids are forbidden in final-summary and every external receipt

shape.parent_identity_id: identity_row id for an exact live parent observed in the same sample
shape.last_sample: sample sequence greater than or equal to first_sample
shape.lineage_root_roles: unique root_role values sorted by ascending UTF-8 bytes and inherited across this edge

shape.sha256: sha256 computed from the same opened file object whose stat fields are recorded

executable_row.path_rule: Canonical executable paths are never output; identity plus selected_executable_match and bundle_tree_match replaces path publication.

shape.sequence: integer in [0,4095] beginning at zero and increasing by exactly one
shape.witnesses: unique domains.witness values sorted by ascending UTF-8 bytes

rules: A valid root control record seeds its exact pid/start identity with that root role only after the identity is observed with an exact match.

For each complete sample, collect every exact child-parent edge observed in that same sample, seed with previously retained lineage plus every exact root observed by that sample, and iterate those same-sample edges to a fixed point before publishing the sample.
A child inherits a root role only through that per-sample fixed point when the exact parent identity is in the retained lineage subset; an edge from another sample cannot create a same-sample chain.

When a browser-root or direct-open-root control exact-matches an identity retained before the control arrived, replay retained complete samples in sequence order beginning with that root's first observation, computing a separate same-sample fixed point at each sample; never compute one fixed point over edges pooled from different samples.
Once inherited, a lineage role is never removed by parent exit, reparenting, later missing PPID edges, or leaving a process group.
Process-group membership and equal PGID are recorded independently and never create, restore, or imply lineage.
PID equality without exact start_sec and start_usec equality never identifies a root, parent, child, or retained member.

A descendant created and reparented wholly between two complete samples cannot support a negative lineage claim; descendant absence is bounded by timing.R_ms, while exact token and bundle-tree outside witnesses remain the fail-closed independent backstop.

shape.identity_digest: process identity sha256 or null before a control exists
shape.first_observed_sample: sample sequence or null until observed
shape.first_absent_sample: first later complete sample proving the exact observed root absent, or null

timing.clock: one monotonic clock shared by all samples; wall clock is forbidden for M, E, R, and window duration
timing.sample_start: taken immediately before process enumeration begins
timing.sample_end: taken only after enumeration, exact identity rechecks, procargs token classification, executable file-identity classification, bundle/selected classification, sorting, and sample digest computation complete; atomic file publication time is excluded
timing.M_ns: maximum start_interval_ns over every non-first sample, including the interval ending at sentinel
timing.E_ns: maximum enumeration_ns over every sample, including first and sentinel
timing.R_ns: M_ns plus E_ns, with checked integer addition
timing.ceil_ms: for nonnegative n nanoseconds: n / 1000000 plus 1 when n modulo 1000000 is nonzero
timing.R_ms: M_ms plus E_ms; this conservative value, not ceil_ms(R_ns), is the external receipt value
timing.minimum_sample_count: floor(window_duration_ms / (limits.start_interval_max_ns / 1000000)), exactly matching the L0 relational formula
timing.coverage: M_ns and E_ns must each be at most 200000000; sample_count must be at least minimum_sample_count; first and sentinel samples are mandatory. No alternative nanosecond division may be used for the L0 count claim.

latest_state.publication_timing: The probe atomically republishes latest-state after every complete sample and after consuming each complete control record, before starting the next sample. A control that changes a root observation is reflected in that publication, so the court can satisfy root_control_causality.browser_ack without waiting for final-summary.

shape.failure_reasons: unique incomplete_reason values sorted by ascending UTF-8 bytes
shape.sample_count: integer in [0,10000] equal to samples length
shape.scan_start_mono_ns: integer or null before first sample
shape.ownership_sample_sequence: sample sequence of the first complete sample started after ownership-boundary, or null
shape.frozen_group_id: run-local integer in [1,2147483647] frozen from the exact browser-root observation, or null
shape.root_observations: exact object with keys browser-root and direct-open-root, each an exact root_observation_state object
shape.early_scanner_stop: boolean; true when the probe stops before publishing the required sentinel for any reason
shape.max_start_interval_ns: integer or null before second sample
shape.max_enumeration_ns: integer or null before first completed sample
shape.resolution_ns: checked sum of max_start_interval_ns and max_enumeration_ns, or null until both exist
shape.samples: array of sample_row, length at most 10000
shape.identities: array of identity_row, length at most 16384
shape.edges: array of edge_row, length at most 32768
shape.executables: array of executable_row referenced by identities, length at most 16384
shape.relevant_events: array of relevant_event_row, length at most 4096

shape.window_duration_ns: integer or null when first or sentinel is missing
shape.max_start_interval_ns: integer or null when fewer than two samples exist
shape.max_enumeration_ns: integer or null when no sample exists
shape.resolution_ns: checked max_start_interval_ns plus max_enumeration_ns, or null unless both maxima exist

shape.window_duration_ms: ceil_ms(window_duration_ns), or null when first or sentinel is missing
shape.max_start_interval_ms: ceil_ms(max_start_interval_ns), or null when fewer than two samples exist
shape.max_enumeration_ms: ceil_ms(max_enumeration_ns), or null when no sample exists
shape.resolution_ms: max_start_interval_ms plus max_enumeration_ms, or null unless both maxima exist
shape.maximum_row_count: integer in [0,4096], or null when no sample exists
shape.maximum_group_member_count: integer in [0,4096], or null when no sample exists
shape.sample_sequence_digest: digest_domains.sample_sequence digest of the ordered sanitized sample array; zero samples uses the literal empty array and does not prove coverage

scan_summary.mapping_rule: When complete is true every nullable field is non-null and the court copies this exact object to receipt.scan; otherwise the court emits the typed scan-coverage failure and does not represent unavailable values as passing facts.

scan_coverage_summary.l0_target: result-template stages.scan-coverage required complete plus every pass_required fact

shape.minimum_sample_count: floor(window_duration_ms / (limits.start_interval_max_ns / 1000000)), or null when window_duration_ms is null
shape.first_sample_complete: boolean true exactly when sequence zero exists, is kind first, and is complete
shape.sentinel_sample_complete: boolean true exactly when one terminal sentinel exists and is complete
shape.sentinel_after_final_inventory: boolean true exactly when sentinel.control_sequence_seen equals the final-inventory-complete sequence and sentinel starts after that record was completely consumed
shape.all_samples_complete: boolean true exactly when every recorded sample is complete
shape.interval_bound_ok: boolean true exactly when every non-first start_interval_ns is at most limits.start_interval_max_ns
shape.enumeration_bound_ok: boolean true exactly when every enumeration_ns is at most limits.enumeration_max_ns
shape.row_bound_ok: boolean true exactly when every process_row_count is at most limits.process_row_max and no process enumeration was truncated
shape.group_member_bound_ok: boolean true exactly when every group_member_count is at most limits.group_member_max and no group enumeration was truncated
shape.count_lower_bound_ok: boolean true exactly when minimum_sample_count is non-null and sample_count is at least minimum_sample_count
shape.early_scanner_stop: boolean true exactly when scanning stops before the required sentinel is atomically published
shape.bundle_tree_resolution_charged: boolean true exactly when every sample end follows all bundle-tree classification work as required by timing.sample_end

scan_coverage_summary.pass_rule: A court scan-coverage stage may pass only when complete and every boolean except early_scanner_stop is true, early_scanner_stop is false, every nullable value is non-null, and all L0 relational limits hold.

ownership_summary.l0_target: result-template stages.ownership required complete plus every pass_required fact
ownership_summary.snapshot_rule: All fields are reduced from the frozen ownership snapshot: the first complete sample started after ownership-boundary, plus sticky retained facts established no later than that sample.

shape.complete: boolean true exactly when the ownership snapshot exists, is complete, and every ownership field was fully classified
shape.contained_group_digest: sha256 or null; digest_domains.contained_group digest of the exact process-identity set ever observed in the frozen group through the ownership snapshot
shape.controlled_lineage_digest: sha256 or null; digest_domains.controlled_lineage digest of the sticky exact process-identity set rooted at browser-root through the ownership snapshot
shape.contained_closure_retained_digest: sha256 or null; digest_domains.contained_closure digest of the union of retained frozen-group membership and controlled browser lineage through the ownership snapshot
shape.contained_closure_live_digest: sha256 or null; digest_domains.contained_closure digest of the live contained closure in the ownership snapshot
shape.token_set_digest: sha256 or null; digest_domains.token_set digest of the exact identity set with exact argv token match in the ownership snapshot
shape.bundle_tree_set_digest: sha256 or null; digest_domains.bundle_tree_set digest of the exact identity set whose opened executable file object is in the frozen bundle tree in the ownership snapshot
shape.bundle_tree_outside_count: integer in [0,4096] or null; bundle-tree matches outside the frozen group without retained controlled-browser lineage or a live G1 exemption
shape.breakaway_deviation_count: integer in [0,16384] or null; retained controlled-browser-lineage identities observed leaving the frozen group through the ownership snapshot
shape.browser_token_match: boolean or null; exact browser-root identity has an exact argv token match in the ownership snapshot
shape.same_sample_insertion_check: boolean or null; every bundle-tree executable enumerated in the frozen group by the ownership snapshot was inserted into the live contained closure in that same sample

ownership_summary.pass_rule: A court ownership stage may pass only when complete is true, every nullable field is non-null, browser_token_match and same_sample_insertion_check are true, and bundle_tree_outside_count is zero.

stage_snapshot_rules.baseline: The complete sequence-zero first sample, taken before any browser-root control exists.
stage_snapshot_rules.session_ready: The first complete sample whose control_sequence_seen is at least the observed browser-root control sequence.
stage_snapshot_rules.ownership: The first complete sample whose control_sequence_seen is at least ownership-boundary.
stage_snapshot_rules.open_request_exit: The first complete sample after direct-open-root was observed that proves that exact root absent.
stage_snapshot_rules.relay_exit: For every scanner-derived relay or topology candidate, the first later complete sample proving that exact identity absent; missing absence never yields an empty-live pass.
stage_snapshot_rules.termination: The first complete sample that proves the previously observed exact browser-root absent; contained group, closure, token and escaped-target facts come from that same sample.
stage_snapshot_rules.final_inventory: The complete sentinel sample whose control_sequence_seen is at least final-inventory-complete.

baseline_summary.l0_target: scanner-owned subsets of result-template stages.preflight and stages.focus-baseline
baseline_summary.snapshot_rule: All fields are reduced from stage_snapshot_rules.baseline; no later sample may repair or replace this baseline.

shape.complete: boolean true exactly when the sequence-zero baseline exists, is complete, and predates every browser-root control
shape.selected_bundle_zero_independent: boolean true exactly when selected_bundle_process_count is zero
shape.independent_inventory_complete: boolean equal to complete; proves target-uid enumeration and every required identity, executable, token, group, and lineage classification for the snapshot completed without truncation or unsupported observation

shape.complete: boolean true exactly when stage_snapshot_rules.session_ready exists and browser-root is observed
shape.independent_inventory_complete: boolean equal to complete; proves target-uid enumeration and every required identity, executable, token, group, and lineage classification for the snapshot completed without truncation or unsupported observation

shape.complete: boolean true exactly when direct-open-root was observed and stage_snapshot_rules.open_request_exit exists
boolean true exactly when the complete candidate universe is classified and every derived relay/candidate exit snapshot exists
shape.relay_identity_digest: the process identity sha256 when classified_relay_count is exactly one; null for zero or multiple relays
shape.primary_predicates_ok: boolean for exactly one classified relay; null otherwise
shape.auxiliary_predicates_ok: boolean for exactly one classified relay; null otherwise
shape.kernel_start_window_ok: boolean for exactly one classified relay; null otherwise
shape.relay_exit_elapsed_ms: for exactly one relay, ceil of its nonnegative kernel wall-clock start to the realtime timestamp taken at the start of its first complete absence sample; null otherwise. A negative value, realtime regression, or detected realtime-to-monotonic offset discontinuity is scan-incomplete
shape.relay_exit_within_deadline: for exactly one classified relay, boolean equal to relay_exit_elapsed_ms less than or equal to limits.relay_exit_deadline_ms; null otherwise

shape.complete: boolean true exactly when stage_snapshot_rules.termination exists and is complete
shape.escaped_target_count: integer in [0,4096] or null; count of live exact identities in the union of the sticky direct, relay, and topology-candidate descendant closures that are outside the contained browser closure at the termination snapshot
shape.independent_inventory_complete: boolean equal to complete; proves target-uid enumeration and every required identity, executable, token, group, and lineage classification for the snapshot completed without truncation or unsupported observation

shape.complete: boolean true exactly when stage_snapshot_rules.final_inventory exists and is complete
shape.independent_inventory_complete: boolean equal to complete; proves target-uid enumeration and every required identity, executable, token, group, and lineage classification for the snapshot completed without truncation or unsupported observation
shape.cleanup_targets_absent: boolean true exactly when no live exact identity in the union of contained-browser, direct, relay, and topology-candidate closures remains eligible for cleanup at the final-inventory snapshot

final_summary.publication_scope: sanitized run-local probe output suitable for court ingestion; contains no PID, PPID, PGID, kernel start identity, path, token, argv, or environment value
final_summary.producer_boundary: The probe publishes latest-state and final-summary only. The court is the sole producer of stage-journal rows, receipt.scan, scan-coverage facts, ownership facts, criteria, and the external receipt.

shape.failure_reasons: unique incomplete_reason values sorted by ascending UTF-8 bytes; empty exactly when status is scan-complete

court_mapping.authority: The court is the sole journal and external receipt producer. It consumes only the sanitized final_summary for scanner-owned external facts and must not copy or derive external facts from latest_state raw identities.
court_mapping.success_scan: For scan-complete, receipt.scan is a byte-value-preserving copy of final_summary.scan and every field is non-null.
court_mapping.failure_scan: For scan-incomplete, receipt.scan still has exactly the final_summary.scan keys and copies its available values; every unavailable scalar is JSON null rather than zero, false, an empty-set digest, omission, or inference.
court_mapping.stage_facts: For each sanitized stage section, the court copies complete and only non-null scanner-owned optional fields into that L0 stage facts object. A null optional value is omitted from the stage facts object and can never satisfy pass_required. The court merges its independently owned public/window/cleanup facts under the L0 exact whitelist.
court_mapping.no_empty_pass: An absent or unobserved root, missing snapshot, incomplete sample, or null scanner-owned field forces the related stage complete false or a typed failure; an empty set or count zero cannot substitute for missing observation.

l0_stage_fact_partition.rule: For every named L0 stage, scanner_owned and court_owned are disjoint and their union is exactly that stage's result-template pass_required list.

boundary_rules.direct-open-executable: digest of the exact direct-open executable; excludes every process-probe file
boundary_rules.qjswasm-host: digest of the exact qjswasm host executable; excludes every process-probe file
boundary_rules.agenterm-cu: digest of the exact agenterm-cu executable; excludes every process-probe file
boundary_rules.independent-process-helper: one logical L0 member jointly commits to the exact process-probe-contract.json bytes, ProcessProbe.c source bytes, build-manifest bytes, and exact single final process-probe executable bytes

input_digest_ownership.independent_process_helper_digest_rule: Compute each logical part SHA-256, RFC 8785 encode the ordered array of [logical-part-id, sha256] pairs in exact logical_part_order, then compute sha256(utf8(agenterm.singleton-safety.v1.frozen-input) || 0x00 || canonical-array-utf8). The outer L0 input digest separately represents this composite as [independent-process-helper, composite-sha256].
input_digest_ownership.single_artifact_rule: One helper has exactly one executable artifact and exactly one independent-process-helper L0 member. Source files, object files, libraries, schemas, build manifests, and the executable must not appear as separate L0 digest members; the contract, C source, build manifest, and final executable are committed through the one composite member digest.

hard_failure_policy: Every configured limit is inclusive; observing one additional item or byte is scan-incomplete.
No list, buffer, file, argv, sample, identity, edge, group membership, control record, event, state, or summary may be truncated and then used for a passing result.

Any incomplete native enumeration, inaccessible required field, identity race, malformed input, unknown JSON field, duplicate key, invalid role transition, timing breach, publication failure, or unsupported observation is scan-incomplete.
Raw argv and environment bytes remain memory-only for exact token classification and are never written to latest-state, final-summary, diagnostics, stderr, or external evidence.
After the first hard failure, forward adjudication stops, but bounded observation needed for sentinel/final facts and atomic final-summary publication continues when possible.
